listing.name: Duke Nukem: Time to Kill — Time to Kill native recomp (MusicMonsterMod)
listing.summary: The project describes a playable native runtime. Complete level and campaign coverage has not been confirmed. See below for original-file requirements and setup. Portcove has not confirmed setup or gameplay.

steps.title: Check the required game files
steps.instruction: Use your own USA SLUS00583 CUE/BIN or CloneCD image. European SLES01515 is rejected.

steps.title: Follow upstream setup
steps.instruction: Build locally from source with your own disc. Modernized mode is the default; use the documented Vanilla flag for the alternate mode.

warnings: The project describes a playable native runtime. Complete level and campaign coverage has not been confirmed.
Portcove has not confirmed setup, gameplay, saves or updates for this experimental port.
